items.question: Im The new mobile phone is being launched today, isn't it? EKw
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Im The new mobile phone is being launched today, isn't it? EKw”，自然应答是“No, not until next week.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：A（No, not until next week.）。
